title: drupilot last test run (last-test.json)
description: The record of the last PHPUnit run, written by scripts/tests/run-phpunit.sh to last-test.json in the subject's hidden state dir (project_state_dir, under drupilot's data dir: DRUPILOT_HOME, else $XDG_DATA_HOME/drupilot; never in the project tree). The same record goes to --result-file FILE (also with --no-record), and --baseline / --baseline-from-last derive test-baseline.json from it. The object is one jq literal, so every key below is always present; scripts/tests/negative-control.sh later rewrites only negative_controls in place. run-phpunit.sh writes nothing without jq.

group.description: A PHPUnit test group: the tests/src/<group> directory of the subject.

baseline_item.description: One failure classified against the pre-port baseline. A test-level item has the test id; a group-level item (a failed or crashed group with no failing test result) has id null.

basis.description: Why it got its class: not-in-baseline / passed-before (regressions), baseline-group-crashed / baseline-not-installable / group-failed-baseline-crashed / group-crashed-baseline-crashed (not baselined), test / group-failed / group-crashed (pre-existing, or a group-level regression).

now.description: The failure message of this run (test-level items).

before.description: The baseline's failure message (pre-existing and baseline-not-installable items).

message_changed.description: True when the failure message differs from the baseline's (it may now fail for another reason).

status.description: failed when a group failed; none-run when no group ran (and none failed); else passed.

ran.description: Groups that ran (an empty or blocked group is not counted).

skipped.description: Groups skipped or blocked (an external blocker).

empty.description: Groups whose PHPUnit executed no test (never counted as passed).

executed.description: Tests executed, from the JUnit logs.

js_skipped_reason.description: Set when the FunctionalJavascript group was skipped because Selenium is not reachable.

blocked_reason.description: Why tests could not run (PHPUnit missing or not executable, else the Selenium note).

subject_has_tests.description: Whether the subject ships any *Test.php under tests/src, whatever --type selected.

groups_with_tests.description: The selected groups that contain at least one *Test.php.

html.description: The coverage HTML directory when --coverage was given.

percent.description: Always null: no percentage is computed.

recorded_at.description: UTC timestamp of the run record.

subject_digest.description: subject_digest of the sources the run tested (freshness checks compare it).

lenient.description: Dependencies mglaman/composer-drupal-lenient let install on the test-bed despite their drupal/core constraint (lenient_packages: the bed's extra.drupal-lenient.allowed-list, ["*"] with allow-all). Never a preservation value (AR-28, CC-14). Absent in a record of drupilot 0.9.

baseline.description: The comparison with test-baseline.json; null when there is no usable baseline, with --no-baseline, or when the comparison failed.

same_code.description: True when the baseline was taken on the current sources (it cannot show what the port changed).

fixed.description: Ids of tests that failed in the baseline and pass now.

negative_controls.description: Summary of negative-controls.json (scripts/tests/negative-control.sh records); null when there is none.

stale.description: Controls run on sources that changed since.

mutation.description: How the guarded change was undone.

group_results.description: One entry per selected group that has tests, in run order.

rc.description: PHPUnit's exit code; null for a group that was not run (skipped).

status.description: empty: PHPUnit ran but executed no test; crashed: it failed without writing any test result; blocked: PHPUnit could not be executed (exit 126/127).

tests.description: Every executed test, from PHPUnit's JUnit logs; empty when they could not be parsed.

id.description: Class::method, with the data-set suffix when there is one.

message.description: First meaningful line of a fail/error message (at most 240 characters); null otherwise.
